meta_description: JLCCNC Keep Production on Lunar New Year Holiday 2025
monitored_text: Home Newsroom Keep Production on Lunar New Year Holiday 2025 Keep Production on Lunar New Year Holiday 2025 Press Release Jan 13, 2025 The Lunar New Year is approaching, and we are so grateful for your support over the past year. The Lunar New Year holiday will span from January 23rd to February 4th . All CNC Machining materials will continue production during the LNY holiday, except for Steel 45#, SUS304. Spray Painting service is unavailable . Note: The build time might be 2-3 days longer than usual during the LNY holiday. During the Lunar New Year holiday, 3D printing and CNC machining orders cannot be combined for shipping, nor can they be combined with PCB/Stencil orders. This will resume on February 5th. Below is the production and shipping schedule. Please kindly schedule the order placement time properly to guarantee the timely completion of your projects. Factory & Shipping Schedule: Order Schedule for reference: Notes: · There is no shipping pickup service on Sunday, January 19th. · The 'Confirm Date' is the day when your order's manufacturing data is complete and the order is prepared for production. If you have any questions about the above information or need order support, please contact our customer service team support@jlcpcb.com .
